title: Psalms 120
paragraphs: ¹ In my distress I cried to the LORD, and he answered me. ² "Deliver me, LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue." ³ What will he give you, what will he do to you, you deceitful tongue? ⁴ Sharp arrows of a warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree. ⁵ How miserable I am, for I dwell in Meshech, living among the tents of Kedar!
⁶ I have lived too long among those who hate peace. ⁷ I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
